$comment: FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicator (KSI) catalog — Concord seed data.
FedRAMP 20x Phase One Key Security Indicators. FedRAMP 20x is an evolving
pilot program; the indicator wording, expected outcomes, and control mappings
below are REPRESENTATIVE and intended to be updated as FedRAMP publishes final
machine-readable KSI definitions. Update this file (not business logic) and
re-run `ccf fedramp20x seed-ksi` to refresh the catalog.
'rule' is a deterministic validation spec evaluated by ccf.fedramp20x.validation.
Supported rule kinds: control_state, control_any, evidence_present,
dependency_authorized, profile_field, connector_capture, manual. See that module.

ksis.name: Phishing-resistant MFA
ksis.description: Enforce phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication for all human users.
ksis.expected_outcome: All interactive user access requires phishing-resistant MFA.

ksis.name: Least-privilege authorization
ksis.description: Grant access using least privilege and role-based authorization.
ksis.expected_outcome: Access is role-based and reviewed; no standing broad privilege.

ksis.name: Centralized identity lifecycle
ksis.description: Provision and de-provision identities through a central authority.
ksis.expected_outcome: Joiner/mover/leaver events flow through a single identity provider.

ksis.name: Deny-by-default network posture
ksis.description: Configure network traffic to deny by default and permit by exception.
ksis.expected_outcome: Ingress/egress is default-deny with explicit, documented allowances.

ksis.name: High availability and rapid recovery
ksis.description: Design the service for high availability and rapid, automated recovery.
ksis.expected_outcome: Service survives component failure and recovers within objectives.

ksis.name: Immutable, minimal attack surface
ksis.description: Use immutable infrastructure and minimize the attack surface.
ksis.expected_outcome: Components are rebuilt from known-good images; unused services disabled.

ksis.name: Encryption in transit
ksis.description: Encrypt all network traffic with strong, current cryptography.
ksis.expected_outcome: All data in transit uses FIPS-validated TLS.

ksis.name: Encryption at rest
ksis.description: Encrypt data at rest using validated cryptographic modules.
ksis.expected_outcome: All stored federal data is encrypted with managed keys.

ksis.name: Centralized secrets management
ksis.description: Manage keys and secrets through a dedicated secrets service.
ksis.expected_outcome: Secrets are stored in a vault, rotated, and never hard-coded.

ksis.name: Centralized security logging
ksis.description: Centrally collect and retain security-relevant logs.
ksis.expected_outcome: Logs from all components are aggregated and retained per policy.

ksis.name: Continuous vulnerability monitoring
ksis.description: Continuously scan for and track vulnerabilities.
ksis.expected_outcome: Vulnerabilities are detected, prioritized, and remediated on a cadence.

ksis.name: Controlled change management
ksis.description: Manage changes through a documented, approved process.
ksis.expected_outcome: Changes are reviewed, approved, and traceable.

ksis.name: Baseline configuration enforcement
ksis.description: Maintain and enforce secure baseline configurations.
ksis.expected_outcome: Deviations from baseline are detected and corrected.

ksis.name: Complete asset inventory
ksis.description: Maintain a complete, current inventory of system components.
ksis.expected_outcome: All components inside the boundary are inventoried and attributed.

ksis.name: Documented security policies
ksis.description: Maintain approved, current security policies and procedures.
ksis.expected_outcome: Policies exist, are approved, and are reviewed on a cadence.

ksis.name: Tested backup and recovery
ksis.description: Back up federal data and test restoration on a defined cadence.
ksis.expected_outcome: Backups exist, are protected, and restores are periodically tested.

ksis.name: Recovery objectives defined
ksis.description: Define and document RTO/RPO recovery objectives.
ksis.expected_outcome: Recovery objectives are documented and validated against tests.

ksis.name: Incident response capability
ksis.description: Maintain and exercise an incident response capability.
ksis.expected_outcome: IR plan exists, roles assigned, and incidents are handled and reported.

ksis.name: US-CERT / FedRAMP incident reporting
ksis.description: Report incidents to the required authorities within mandated timelines.
ksis.expected_outcome: A defined path reports incidents to CISA/FedRAMP within SLAs.

ksis.name: Security awareness training
ksis.description: Provide role-based security awareness training to all personnel.
ksis.expected_outcome: Personnel complete security training on hire and annually.

ksis.name: FedRAMP-authorized dependencies
ksis.description: Use FedRAMP-authorized services for underlying cloud dependencies.
ksis.expected_outcome: All underlying IaaS/PaaS/SaaS dependencies are FedRAMP authorized.

ksis.name: Third-party risk management
ksis.description: Assess and monitor the risk of third-party information resources.
ksis.expected_outcome: Third parties are risk-assessed and monitored over time.
